description: Ingestion cases for POST and GET /api/v1/integrations/fpp/playlist-entry-observations, docs/build/FPP-PLUGIN-COORDINATOR-CONTRACTS.md section 1.6 and its section 1.7 refusal table. Each case drives the real coordinator HTTP handler. scope selects the bearer principal's role: "fpp:observe" mints a principal holding fpp:observe (RoleScheduler), "show:macro:run" mints a principal holding show:macro:run but not fpp:observe (RoleOperator), and "none" sends no Authorization header at all. priorCases names earlier cases in this same file whose bodies must be POSTed first, in order, against a fresh store, to set up sequence or replay state before this case's own body is posted. The oversized-body case cannot be expressed as a literal 16 KiB JSON value without bloating this file; see oversizedBodyBytes below and the README.

cases.name: no-credential-refused-401
cases.description: No Authorization header at all. Refused before the body is even parsed.

cases.name: wrong-scope-refused-403
cases.description: A principal holding show:macro:run (the operator role) but not fpp:observe. Deliberately not in the operator bundle: an operator credential must not be able to forge plugin evidence.

cases.name: oversized-body-refused-413
cases.description: A body larger than the 16384 byte bound, refused before it is parsed. No body field: the consumer synthesizes a request body of oversizedBodyBytes bytes, for example by JSON-encoding an observation whose playlistName is padded with filler characters until the encoded body reaches that length, and posts it as raw bytes.

cases.name: malformed-json-refused-400
cases.description: Structurally invalid JSON. body is omitted; rawBodyOverride carries the literal bytes to post instead of JSON-encoding a body object, since this case's wire content is not valid JSON.

cases.name: unknown-field-refused-400
cases.description: A syntactically valid body carrying a field this schema version does not define. Unknown fields are refused, not ignored.

cases.name: unsupported-schema-version-refused-400
cases.description: schemaVersion 2. This coordinator accepts only schemaVersion 1.

cases.name: missing-instance-uuid-refused-400
cases.description: instanceUuid is the empty string. instanceUuid is required on every observation regardless of unavailable.

cases.name: invalid-action-refused-400
cases.description: action outside the fixed vocabulary (start, playing, stop, query_next, unknown).

cases.name: invalid-unavailable-refused-400
cases.description: unavailable set to a value outside the section 1.4 vocabulary.

cases.name: negative-position-refused-400
cases.description: position is negative.

cases.name: malformed-playlist-hash-refused-400
cases.description: playlistHash is not 64 lowercase hex characters.

cases.name: malformed-entry-key-refused-400
cases.description: entryKey is not 64 lowercase hex characters.

cases.name: negative-sequence-refused-400
cases.description: sequence is negative.

cases.name: negative-coalesced-refused-400
cases.description: coalescedSincePreviousAcknowledged is negative.

cases.name: entry-key-mismatch-refused-400
cases.description: A syntactically valid 64-hex entryKey that does not match the entry key re-derived from instanceUuid, playlistName, playlistHash, section, and position.

cases.name: plain-accepted-observation
cases.description: A well-formed, available-identity observation with no prior state for this instance. Accepted unconditionally.

cases.name: sequence-seed-accepted
cases.description: Seeds instance-seed at sequence 5. Used as a priorCases dependency by the replay, conflict, regression, and higher-sequence cases below, and is itself a plain accepted-observation case.

cases.name: identical-replay-is-idempotent
cases.description: The exact same instanceUuid, sequence, and canonical body as sequence-seed-accepted, posted a second time. Idempotent: 200, accepted false, replay true, and the stored row is unchanged (a consumer that only checks the wire fixtures cannot assert the store directly, but can assert the response fields).

cases.name: sequence-conflict-different-body-refused-409
cases.description: The same instanceUuid and sequence as sequence-seed-accepted, but a different section, so the canonical body differs. Refused: a sequence must not be reused for two different observations.

cases.name: sequence-regression-refused-409
cases.description: A sequence lower than sequence-seed-accepted's already-accepted sequence 5. Refused, and the stored latest observation is left untouched (contract section 1.5).

cases.name: higher-sequence-accepted-after-prior
cases.description: A sequence higher than sequence-seed-accepted's already-accepted sequence 5. Accepted, replacing the stored latest observation for this instance.

cases.name: unavailable-missing-instance-uuid-with-uuid-present-accepted
cases.description: unavailable is missing_instance_uuid, but instanceUuid IS present (some other identity input failed). Per contract section 1.4, missing_instance_uuid is reportable only when some other identity input failed, never as the reason a body arrived with no instance at all, so this is accepted, not refused.

cases.name: unavailable-missing-playlist-name-accepted
cases.description: unavailable is missing_playlist_name. Unavailable observations are not refusals: the coordinator stores and streams them.

cases.name: unavailable-missing-definition-accepted
cases.description: unavailable is missing_definition.

cases.name: unavailable-unsupported-definition-shape-accepted
cases.description: unavailable is unsupported_definition_shape.

cases.name: unavailable-negative-position-accepted
cases.description: unavailable is negative_position. No position field is sent: the plugin reports the reason it could not establish identity rather than sending the offending negative value, which would itself be refused by the position check.

cases.name: unavailable-truncated-identity-field-accepted
cases.description: unavailable is truncated_identity_field.

cases.name: unavailable-no-instance-uuid-refused-400
cases.description: unavailable is missing_instance_uuid AND instanceUuid is itself empty. Refused: an unavailable observation cannot be attributed to no instance at all.

cases.name: unavailable-with-playlist-hash-refused-400
cases.description: unavailable is set AND playlistHash is present. playlistHash and entryKey are derived identity: nothing computed them for an unavailable observation, so a value in either is a claim nothing verified, and is refused rather than stored (contract section 1.2, section 1.4).

cases.name: unavailable-with-entry-key-refused-400
cases.description: unavailable is set AND entryKey is present. Same rule as unavailable-with-playlist-hash-refused-400, for the other derived-identity field.

cases.name: available-missing-identity-fields-refused-400
cases.description: unavailable is absent, and playlistName, playlistHash, and position are all absent, but entryKey carries the correctly re-derived hash of the all-empty five-member identity object (instanceUuid present, every other field empty). Before this fix, a caller could precompute this hash and pass the entry-key re-derivation check trivially; contract section 1.6 step 7 now refuses this before re-derivation even runs, because playlistName, playlistHash, and position are themselves required whenever unavailable is absent.

cases.name: available-with-empty-section-accepted
cases.description: unavailable is absent, section is present but the empty string, and every other identity field is present and correct. section may legitimately be empty; only playlistName may not.

cases.name: replay-different-member-order-is-idempotent
cases.description: The same instanceUuid, sequence, and semantic content as sequence-seed-accepted, but with its members in a different wire order, carried in rawBody so the consumer posts exactly these bytes instead of re-marshaling a Go map (which would sort the keys and silently defeat this case). Replay detection hashes the CANONICAL body, so member order must not matter: 200, accepted false, replay true, nothing stored.

cases.name: sequence-conflict-different-order-and-content-refused-409
cases.description: Mirror of replay-different-member-order-is-idempotent: the same sequence as sequence-seed-accepted, a different wire member order AND genuinely different content (section other instead of main), carried in rawBody. Reordering must not accidentally mask a genuine conflict as a replay: still refused 409.
